events.label: Наука
entries: 1684 – Isaac Newton's derivation of Kepler's laws from his theory of gravity, contained in the paper De motu corporum in gyrum, is read to the Royal Society by Edmond Halley.

events.label: Искусство
entries: 1896 – Alfred Jarry's Ubu Roi premieres in Paris. A riot breaks out at the end of the performance.

events.label: Образование
entries: 1665 – The Royal Netherlands Marine Corps is founded by Michiel de Ruyter.
2015 – Rojava conflict: The Syrian Democratic Council is established in Dêrik, forming the political wing of the Syrian Democratic Forces in northeast Syria.

events.label: Литература
entries: 1768 – The first edition of the Encyclopædia Britannica is published.
1909 – Selma Lagerlöf becomes the first female writer to receive the Nobel Prize in Literature.
1953 – British Prime Minister Winston Churchill receives the Nobel Prize in Literature.
